text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: What is it, Tran? Another new gadget?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait a sec~... Whoa, it already 
started recording! You two—ready, say 
cheese!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Fufuun. I knew you could do it♪

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Collecting footage of unknown purpose 
again...? I can hardly imagine how this 
helps with racing.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, so it's useful in other ways too, 
huh~. Even if they look like they'd 
clash~... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: First to answer wins! What is 1 + 1?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Man, I managed to capture some 
great footage again~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Whenever I'm tired, I'll just look at 
this to cheer myself up~)
